payload.title: File:Neuquenraptor Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of Neuquenraptor argentinus. Known material shown in white, missing regions restored after Buitreraptor. The human silhouette is from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg (CC0).

References:

  • Brissón Egli, F., Rolando Aranciaga, A.M., Agnolín,F.L., and Novas, F.E. (2017). "Osteology of the unenlagiid theropod Neuquenraptor argentinus from the Late Cretaceous of Patagonia". Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 62 (3): 549–562.
  • (in English) Novas, Fernando E.; Brissón, Egli; Federico, Agnolin; Federico L.; Gianechini, Federico A.; Cerda, Ignacio (2018). "Postcranial osteology of a new specimen of Buitreraptor gonzalezorum (Theropoda, Unenlagiidae)". Cretaceous Research 83: 127–167. DOI:10.1016/j.cretres.2017.06.003. ISSN 0195-6671.
  • File:Buitreraptor gonzalezorum.jpg
